audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0..6].side all read flat 'Skill' while content win[0..6] already reads Rakan for all seven rows, and whys[]/spikes[]/early/mid/late all consistently argue Rakan stays ahead the whole matchup including late. The two layers contradicted each other.
audit.why: The level chart told a reader 'even skill matchup' while every sentence beneath it said Rakan wins every stage — direct self-contradiction.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..6].side to Rakan (matching win[], already correct — no content edit needed), rewrote each .why with the specific reason, and lowered ratings to reflect a consistent Rakan-favored matchup that tightens slightly late.

audit.why: Level 2 W-engage spike, level 6 R AoE charm chase, and the first-item double-dash mobility edge are already correctly named in spikes[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions were unmentioned: Gleaming Quill (Q) heals Rakan's allies on hit, so Grievous Wounds timing decides whether extended poke sticks; and Fey Feathers (P) plus Battle Dance (E) both give him a shield that absorbs a burst window.
audit.why: Both were flagged as applicable-but-unmentioned for this matchup and directly change when to commit burst versus poke.

edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Unbreakable banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Grand Entrance (W) sits on a 14s cooldown, 10s at rank 5 — the leap knockup starts every play, track him in fog. Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown and extends the mobility. Keep Unbreakable banked for his engage. The Quickness (130s at rank 1) is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Good trade: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all. Bad trade: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Good trade: force out Fey Feathers' shield or a Battle Dance recast before committing burst — both absorb your window. Bad trade: extended poke once Gleaming Quill lands on him — Grievous Wounds timing decides if that heal sticks.
